resources.string: Check your connection and try again.
Sign in to use Gradey AI
Gradey AI needs a Gradey ID so its cloud conversations stay separate from local-only school data.
This build is missing its local Firebase configuration. Your school data stays on this device.
Gradey AI is an artificial intelligence system. Before you start, review how it handles your information.
Gradey AI is an artificial intelligence system, not a person. Replies are generated automatically (EU AI Act, Art. 50).
Gradey shares only a limited snapshot of your marks and timetable needed to answer. It never shares your school password.

Your prompts, recent chat history, and limited school context are sent securely through Firebase Functions to Microsoft Azure AI. Your school credentials and raw school-provider payloads are never sent.
Guest chats are deleted after 30 days of inactivity. You can delete chats or revoke consent at any time.
You are interacting with an AI system, not a person. Replies are generated automatically and can be wrong. Verify important information.
You can still view chats and manage Gradey AI settings. Sending new messages will be available again soon.
Your live availability and consent status came from the Gradey AI service.
Conversation history and chat streaming are not available in this Android build yet.
